current_findings: Ross 2011 provides the cleanest first physical prototype candidate in the Ross lineage
the finite-volume continuity algebra has now been independently executed and conserves mass to roundoff across 1 to 128 cells and sigma 0, 0.5 and 1
one tridiagonal O(N) solve per internal step is executable without global nonlinear iteration
the test base state remained bitwise unchanged, supporting transaction-safe trial semantics
this success does not yet qualify physical face tables, SWAP hydraulics, saturated-unsaturated switching or timestep accuracy
full SWAP hydraulic catalog, MODFLOW boundary duality and response tangent remain open
next_action: qualify a real precomputed steady-Darcian face table against a shared authoritative face oracle, first for unsaturated homogeneous fixtures and unseen interpolation probes, before integrating it into the continuity algebra harness
